members.name: wait
members.description:
Wait the given number of seconds before moving on. If no time is given,
waits for 0.05 seconds.  Motor control keeps running while it waits.

members.name: wait_until
members.description: Wait until the given condition (type: () -> bool) is satisfied.

members.name: wait_while
members.description: Wait while the given condition (type: () -> bool) is satisfied.

members.name: countdown
members.description:
A timer that counts down from the given number of seconds, starting
when it is made.  It is true while there is time left, so

    timer = countdown(2)
    while timer:
        robot.drive(50)

repeats for two seconds, and a `for` loop over one gives the seconds
left each time round:

    for time_left in countdown(2):
        print(time_left)

Each countdown keeps its own time, so several can run at once.

members.name: drive_motor
members.description: A DC motor plugged in to a drive port, with or without an encoder.

members.name: drivetrain
members.description: A robot's wheel motors, driven as one: `drivetrain(left, right)`, or `drivetrain(front_left, front_right, back_left, back_right)`. The first, third... are the left wheels, the second, fourth... the right.

members.name: button
members.description: A button, either built into the board or plugged into a GROVE port.

members.name: encoder
members.description:
An encoder, plugged in to the signal pins of a port.  It can be on its
own or built into a DC motor; a drive motor with an encoder makes its
own, which `get_encoder()` returns.

members.name: L1
members.description: Light L1, built into the board, ready to use: `L1.on()`.

members.name: L2
members.description: Light L2, built into the board, ready to use: `L2.on()`.

members.name: A
members.description: Button A, built into the board, ready to use: `A.pressed()`. It also starts the program.

members.name: B
members.description: Button B, built into the board, ready to use: `B.pressed()`.

members.name: C
members.description: Button C, built into the board, ready to use: `C.pressed()`.

members.name: D
members.description: Button D, built into the board, ready to use: `D.pressed()`.

drive_motor.name: spin
drive_motor.description:
Spin the motor at the given power, from -100 to 100, for the given
number of seconds.  If no time is given, spins for 0.05 seconds.
With an encoder the motor keeps a steady speed whatever the load.

The motor stops when the time is up.  Calling `spin` again straight
away carries on from where it was, so a loop of `spin` calls runs
the motor smoothly, and a loop that spins two motors in turn keeps
both running.

drive_motor.name: spin_back
drive_motor.description: Spin the motor backwards; the same as `spin` with the power negated.

drive_motor.name: spin_degrees
drive_motor.description:
Spin the motor through the given number of degrees, negative for
backwards, at the given power, then brake.  Needs an encoder.
Turns add up exactly: two `spin_degrees(90)` make a half turn.

drive_motor.name: spin_back_degrees
drive_motor.description: Spin the motor backwards through the given number of degrees, then brake.

drive_motor.name: hold
drive_motor.description:
Holds the motor where it is for the given number of seconds.  If no
time is given, holds for 0.05 seconds.  With an encoder it pushes
back against a load to stay at its angle; without one it brakes.
Like `spin`, it stops when the time is up, so call it in a loop to
keep holding.

drive_motor.name: stop
drive_motor.description: Stops the motor and lets it turn freely.

drive_motor.name: brake
drive_motor.description: Stops the motor and holds it from turning freely.

drive_motor.name: get_encoder
drive_motor.description: Returns the motor's encoder, or None if it has none.

drive_motor.name: free_port
drive_motor.description: Frees the port for use by other components, disabling this motor.

drivetrain.name: drive
drivetrain.description:
Drives straight at the given power, from -100 to 100, for the given
number of seconds.  If no time is given, drives for 0.05 seconds.

The motors stop when the time is up.  Calling this again straight
away carries on, so a loop of calls drives smoothly.  `drive` and
`turn` called in the same loop add up, and the robot drives an arc.

drivetrain.name: turn
drivetrain.description: Turns on the spot, the left wheels forwards; like `drive` otherwise.

drivetrain.name: curve
drivetrain.description: Drives the left and right wheels at different powers; like `drive` otherwise.

drivetrain.name: drive_back
drivetrain.description: Drives backwards; the same as `drive` with the power negated.

drivetrain.name: turn_back
drivetrain.description: Turns the other way; the same as `turn` with the power negated.

drivetrain.name: curve_back
drivetrain.description: Curves backwards; the same as `curve` with both powers negated.

drivetrain.name: drive_degrees
drivetrain.description:
Drives straight until every wheel has turned through the given
number of degrees, then brakes.  These are degrees of the wheels,
not of the robot.  Needs encoders on every motor.

drivetrain.name: turn_degrees
drivetrain.description: Turns on the spot until every wheel has turned the given degrees; like `drive_degrees`.

drivetrain.name: curve_degrees
drivetrain.description:
Turns the left and right wheels through their own number of
degrees, all finishing together, then brakes.  The side with
further to go moves at the given power.

drivetrain.name: drive_back_degrees
drivetrain.description: Drives backwards by degrees; the same as `drive_degrees` negated.

drivetrain.name: turn_back_degrees
drivetrain.description: Turns the other way by degrees; the same as `turn_degrees` negated.

drivetrain.name: curve_back_degrees
drivetrain.description: Curves backwards by degrees; the same as `curve_degrees` with both negated.

drivetrain.name: stop
drivetrain.description: Stops every motor and lets them turn freely.

drivetrain.name: brake
drivetrain.description: Stops every motor and holds them from turning freely.

button.name: pressed
button.description: Returns true if the button is pressed, false otherwise.

button.name: held
button.description: Returns true if the button is held, false otherwise.

button.name: free_port
button.description: Frees the port for use by other buttons, disabling this one.

encoder.name: get_degrees
encoder.description: Returns how far the shaft has turned, in degrees, since the program started.

encoder.name: get_speed
encoder.description:
Returns how fast the shaft is turning, in degrees per second,
negative for backwards.

encoder.name: free_port
encoder.description: Frees the port for use by other components, disabling this encoder.

light.name: flash
light.description: Turns the LED on for the given number of seconds, then off.

light.name: toggle
light.description: Toggles the LED on or off, whichever it currently isn't.

light.name: free_port
light.description: Frees the port for use by other LEDs, disabling this one.
